headline: Teacher conference, women in AI, adult community literacy
digest: Actua, MIT RAISE and TMU announced the AI Exchange, a global conference on K-12 AI literacy (Aug 17–18). Amii marked ten years of the AI4Good Lab (85 women and gender-diverse participants). RBC Foundation funded Digital Moment's AI Learning Labs. In the UK, Edinburgh Futures Institute piloted a community AI Literacy Challenge with a homelessness charity, and a north-west AI bootcamp for 16–21-year-olds launched. Timnit Gebru's Democracy Now! interview offered a critical counterweight on AI hype and racial bias.
